title: dyssodia belenidium
intro: Dyssodia belenidium, commonly known as "Belenidium" or "Wild Marigold", is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and the southwestern United States. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Dyssodia belenidium include treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues, as well as providing relief from fever and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
